item.title: Alabama emergency management director talks Hurricane Isaias
item.description: Hurricane Isaias is hours away from making landfall along the Gulf Coast. Jeff Smitherman, director of the Alabama Emergency Management Agency, joins CBS News to discuss the preparation measures his state is taking.

item.title: Panama struck by 2 powerful earthquakes, U.S. Geological Survey says
item.description: Panama was struck by a powerful magnitude 7.7 earthquake followed by a 6.6 magnitude quake later in the day.

item.title: Lost pet recovery specialist reunites 66-year-old widow with her dogs after car accident
item.description: Annie Olup was driving in heavy rain when she hit a guardrail and flipped her car, causing her two dogs to escape from the wreckage. Steve Hartman has the story of how a pet recovery specialist brought them home.

item.title: Watch: Bodycam footage shows Virginia police's heroic response to house fire as man trapped
item.description: New bodycam footage reveals the heroic efforts of police officers in Culpeper, Virginia, to rescue a man trapped inside his bedroom during a house fire. Kris Van Cleave reports.

item.title: A look at NFL legend Mike Ditka's legacy after his death at 86
item.description: Mike Ditka, an NFL Hall of Famer and Super Bowl-winning coach, died Friday at age 86. Mark Strassman has more.

item.title: Map shows ICE shootings in U.S. during immigration crackdown
item.description: Map shows details on each of the shootings carried out by DHS agents during the president's second term.

item.title: Philadelphia police say Anthropic AI submitted a "false homicide tip"
item.description: Anthropic notified the Philadelphia Police Department of the incident and later published a report describing what happened.

item.title: Republicans divided over Pentagon's plan to livestream execution of Fort Hood shooter
item.description: Republicans are speaking out in response to Pete Hegseth's announcement that Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan's execution will be livestreamed. Ed O'Keefe has the details.

item.title: Trump launches new investigation into Fed Gov. Lisa Cook
item.description: President Trump says a committee will investigate Federal Reserve Gov. Lisa Cook and determine whether there is cause to remove her from the board. CBS News homeland security correspondent Nicole Sganga has the details.

item.title: What to watch as legal drama "Cupertino" premieres on CBS
item.description: Joe Otterson, a TV news editor at Variety, joins "The Daily Report" to share the hottest new TV shows to watch.

item.title: Head of ICE enforcement says man shot in NYC with child in backseat "weaponized his vehicle"
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security is responding to outrage over the NYC shooting of Oscar Bergal, who was transporting his 5-year-old child in his car's backseat. Camilo Montoya-Galvez reports.

item.title: The history of public executions in the U.S. amid Nidal Hasan's planned firing squad death
item.description: The Pentagon is planning a public execution for Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan in December. Charlie D'Agata reports, and Lynn Novick, director of "Crime and Punishment in America," an upcoming PBS series, joins "The Daily Report" to discuss the history of the death penalty in the U.S.

item.title: Category 3 Hurricane Isaias just hours away from making landfall on Gulf Coast
item.description: Category 3 Hurricane Isaias is expected to hit parts of the Gulf Coast Friday night, bringing life-threatening conditions and up to 9 feet of storm surge. Jason Allen reports, and Rob Marciano has the forecast.

item.title: Man in custody after being shot by ICE agent in New York City
item.description: A 28-year-old man is in custody in Brooklyn, New York, after being shot inside a car by an ICE agent while his 5-year-old son was sitting in the back seat. CBS News immigration correspondent Camilo Montoya-Galvez reports.

item.title: Cook Political Report shifts 18 more House seats in Democrats' favor ahead of midterms
item.description: A new Cook Political Report shifted 18 more House seats in democratic candidates' favor, with midterms just 25 days away. CBS News' political director Fin Gómez breaks it down.

item.title: Hurricane Isaias lashing Gulf Coast ahead of landfall
item.description: Hurricane Isaias is already bringing Category 3 conditions to parts of the Gulf Coast ahead of its expected landfall late Friday night. CBS News' Jason Allen and Rob Marciano are on the ground in Alabama and Florida with a look at the latest conditions.

item.title: Judge strikes down DOJ's policy of reviewing state voter rolls
item.description: A federal judge has struck down the Trump administration's plan to check state voter rolls against federal immigration databases and press states to remove voters it determines are registered illegally.

item.title: Trump creates committee to investigate Fed's Lisa Cook
item.description: President Trump established a committee to look into allegations that Fed Governor Lisa Cook made false statements on mortgage documents, the latest step in his renewed effort to fire her.

item.title: "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" guests for Oct. 11, 2026
item.description: This week's guests include Secretary of Homeland Security Markwayne Mullin, Senate Majority Whip John Barrasso and Democratic Sen. Chris Murphy.

item.title: Hurricane Isaias halts oil production, threatening prices
item.description: Major oil producers like Chevron and Shell are shutting down production in the Gulf Coast and evacuating offshore facilities as Hurricane Isaias barrels toward the region. Forward Energy founder and principal Joe Brettell joins "The Takeout" to discuss how the storm could impact energy markets.

item.title: Trump picks "loyal" Katie Zacharia as next White House press secretary
item.description: "I am confident that Katie will deliver strong results for our Country as the next White House Press Secretary," President Trump said.

item.title: Cook Political Report shifts 18 House races toward Democrats
item.description: Democrats are seeing another indication of momentum heading into the midterms, with the Cook Political Report shifting 18 more House races toward the party. Atlanta Journal-Constitution Washington bureau chief Tia Mitchell and Washington Sun senior editor Dave Levinthal join "The Takeout" to discuss.

item.title: Doctor and medical ethicist unpacks Christa Pike's botched execution
item.description: Attorneys for convicted murderer Christa Pike say she is slowly recovering from a botched attempt to execute her with lethal injections. Dr. Lydia Dugdale, a doctor of internal medicine at New York Presbyterian Hospital and a medical ethicist, joins "The Takeout" to discuss the case.

item.title: Trump announces Russia will release millions of tons of diesel to help with costs
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin agreed to release 300,000 tons of diesel immediately and millions more over the coming months.

item.title: NYPD body camera footage shows aftermath of ICE agent shooting in Marble Hill
item.description: Oscar Bergal, 28, was shot once in the neck by an ICE agent who fired shots at his car Thursday afternoon, according to authorities.

item.title: Turbulence injures eight on Avianca flight that was forced to divert to MIA
item.description: The Avianca flight was headed from Colombia to New York City when the turbulence forced it to divert to MIA, officials say.

item.title: Hurricane Isaias becomes Category 3 storm as it threatens northern Gulf Coast
item.description: Hurricane Isaias, the first Atlantic hurricane of 2026, is inching closer to the northern Gulf Coast, where it is expected to make landfall on Friday evening.

item.title: These 18 million households now rank as America's richest
item.description: The smallest age group in the U.S. is also the richest, with a 37% jump in net worth over the last three years — far higher than any other group.

item.title: 10/9: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: New York City officials condemn ICE after agent shoots man; candidates clash during Senate debates in Georgia and Michigan.

item.title: Firsthand look at the high-tech hunt for cargo thieves
item.description: Cargo theft has become a multibillion-dollar business, and consumers are paying the price.
